---
title: "Blood Pressure Analysis"

format:
  dashboard:
    theme: cosmo
    scrolling: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

csv_path <- "data/data1000.csv"
rds_paths <- c("data/NEWdata2.RDS", "data/NEWdata2.rds")
rds_path <- rds_paths[file.exists(rds_paths)][1]

if (file.exists(csv_path)) {
  raw <- read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else if (!is.na(rds_path)) {
  raw <- as.data.frame(readRDS(rds_path))
} else {
  stop(" ")
}

required <- c("RIDAGEYR", "BPXOSY1", "BPXODI1", "RIAGENDR", "RIDRETH1")
missing_columns <- setdiff(required, names(raw))
if (length(missing_columns)) {
  stop("Missing columns ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
}
# Data preparation 

sex_label <- function(x) {
  z <- trimws(as.character(x))
  dplyr::case_when(
    z %in% c("1", "Male", "male") ~ "Male",
    z %in% c("2", "Female", "female") ~ "Female",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}
race_label <- function(x) {
  z <- trimws(as.character(x))
  dplyr::case_when(
    z == "1" ~ "Mexican American",
    z == "2" ~ "Other Hispanic",
    z == "3" ~ "Non-Hispanic White",
    z == "4" ~ "Non-Hispanic Black",
    z == "6" ~ "Non-Hispanic Asian",
    z == "7" ~ "Other Race - Including Multi-Racial",
    TRUE ~ z
  )
}

race_reference_order <- c(
  "Other Race - Including Multi-Racial", "Other Hispanic",
  "Non-Hispanic White", "Mexican American", "Non-Hispanic Black",
  "Non-Hispanic Asian"
)
race_values <- race_label(raw$RIDRETH1)
race_levels <- c(race_reference_order,
                 setdiff(unique(stats::na.omit(race_values)), race_reference_order))

adult_data <- raw |>
  mutate(
    RIDAGEYR = as.numeric(RIDAGEYR),
    BPXOSY1 = as.numeric(BPXOSY1),
    BPXODI1 = as.numeric(BPXODI1),
    sex = factor(sex_label(RIAGENDR), levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    race = factor(race_label(RIDRETH1), levels = race_levels)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(RIDAGEYR), RIDAGEYR >= 20, RIDAGEYR < 80)

analysis_a <- adult_data |> filter(complete.cases(BPXOSY1, BPXODI1))
analysis_b <- adult_data |> filter(complete.cases(BPXOSY1, sex))
analysis_c <- adult_data |> filter(complete.cases(BPXOSY1, race))

if (nrow(analysis_a) < 3 || nrow(analysis_b) < 3 || nrow(analysis_c) < 3 ||
    n_distinct(analysis_b$sex) != 2 || n_distinct(analysis_c$race) < 2) {
  stop("Too few complete observations or groups for the requested analyses.")
}

```

# Analysis A: Systolic and diastolic

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Association between diastolic and systolic pressure
ggplot(analysis_a, aes(x = BPXODI1, y = BPXOSY1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.17, size = 0.7, color = "#355070") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE,
              color = "#c44944") +
  labs(x = "Diastolic blood pressure (mmHg)",
       y = "Systolic blood pressure (mmHg)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
#| title: Association by sex
analysis_a |> filter(!is.na(sex)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = BPXODI1, y = BPXOSY1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.6, color = "#397c91") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE,
              color = "#bd503d") +
  facet_wrap(~ sex) +
  labs(x = "Diastolic blood pressure (mmHg)",
       y = "Systolic blood pressure (mmHg)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

# Analysis B: Systolic pressure by sex

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Distribution of systolic pressure by sex
ggplot(analysis_b, aes(x = BPXOSY1)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, fill = "#eb805e", color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ sex) +
  labs(x = "Systolic blood pressure (mmHg)", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
#| title: Violon plot and boxplot by sex
ggplot(analysis_b, aes(x = sex, y = BPXOSY1, fill = sex)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.65, trim = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.13, alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE,
               outlier.alpha = 0.25) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "#e88a81", "Male" = "#64b6c7")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Systolic blood pressure (mmHg)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

# Analysis C: Systolic pressure by race/ethnicity

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Systolic pressure by race/ethnicity
ggplot(analysis_c, aes(x = race, y = BPXOSY1)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#7a74c1", outlier.alpha = 0.25) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Systolic blood pressure (mmHg)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

```{r}
#| title: Distribution within groups
ggplot(analysis_c, aes(x = BPXOSY1)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, fill = "#e98b69", color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ race, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Systolic blood pressure (mmHg)", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Density curves
ggplot(analysis_c, aes(x = BPXOSY1, fill = race, color = race)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.16) +
  labs(x = "Systolic blood pressure (mmHg)",
       y = "Density", color = "Race/ethnicity", fill = "Race/ethnicity") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```
